LanguageData.CC_Kept_Sub: What the council granted that could still be taken away. Moving, storing or rebuilding it is fine; if it stays gone past the grace period, they'll take it as the council going back on its word.
LanguageData.CC_Kept_Tip_Kept: Granted {AGO} ago. Watched for {LEFT} more: if it's taken away before then, {PAWN_nameDef} will mind. Moving or rebuilding it is fine. After that, the colony has lived with it, and changing it is just life.
LanguageData.CC_Kept_Tip_Missing: Put it back within {LEFT} and nothing comes of it.
LanguageData.CC_Kept_Tip_TakenBack: {PAWN_nameDef} took it as the council going back on its word. Put it back within {LEFT} to make it right: the bad mood ends early and half the lost trust comes back. Meanwhile {PAWN_pronoun} may ask for it again.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_TakenBack: Granted wishes can be taken back
LanguageData.CC_Settings_TakenBack_Tip: A wish that stays (a bed kept for guests, a room of their own, a telescope, the work they love) is watched for about 60 days after it's granted, longer for rooms. If what was given is taken away and not put back within the grace period, the colonist who asked takes it as the council going back on its word: a bad mood, the trust a broken promise costs, and a line in their journal. Moving, storing or rebuilding it doesn't count, and neither does a fire or a raid.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_TakenBack: Taking away what a wish gave (a bed, a room, a workbench) upsets the one who asked.
LanguageData.CC_SetTip_KeptGrace: How long something granted may be gone (moved, reassigned, rebuilt) before the colonist who asked for it minds. You're told the moment it goes missing.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_KeptGrace_Off: No grace: they mind the next time the council looks, within two hours.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_KeptGrace_Short: Half a day to move it or put it back before they mind.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_KeptGrace_Normal: A day to move it or put it back before they mind.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_KeptGrace_Long: Three days to move it or put it back before they mind.
